scope: Currently available baseline screenshot plus Library candidates IMG_4369, IMG_4370, IMG_4373, IMG_4374. This is bounded exhaustion of these candidates, not universal exhaustion of all possible pan/zoom captures.

registration_gate.method: SIFT ratio-match + RANSAC homography, supplemented by multi-scale edge-template search

minimum_for_same_ground_binding.note: A four-point exact homography is degenerate for identity purposes and cannot establish same-ground identity.

coordinate_behavior_result.reason: No currently available candidate passed the same-ground registration gate against the immutable baseline.

candidate_authoritative_sources_identifi.source: USDA-FPAC Puerto Rico/USVI 2009-2010 30 cm orthophotography ImageServer

independent_source_result.reason: Exact baseline ground footprint is not yet authoritatively bound. Source-family difference alone is not canonical source independence and cannot be used to compare the boundary.

invariants: No NAME_ONLY, NEAREST_ONLY, temporal-neighbor image, or same-flight context is promoted to same-ground identity.
A degenerate four-point homography cannot establish same-ground identity.
Source taxonomy is not source identity.
Pan/zoom and independent-basemap gates remain blocked until the exact ground footprint is bound.
All competing causal origins remain preserved until an origin-specific falsification or promotion gate passes.
